title: TAPP Composition Module: ReportingCore
description:
The shared ReportingCore block of the 2026-08-11 TAPP library (Claude Skills for TAPP/Module_ReportingCore.csv), composed by 16 of the sixteen delivery tables. 6 owned fields over 10 schema paths.

GENERATED by tools/build_module_bb.py from the module's CSV and its schema-path sidecar — edit those, not this file. Requiredness follows the TAPP tier matrix: a field Basic on a side is required there, Advanced is permitted, N/A is absent from that side entirely.

This is a PROFILE, not a vocabulary: it asserts which properties a conforming procedure or analysis carries. Column F (Example / Allowed Content) is consumer-owned per the module manifest, so no enum is pinned here — a consuming TAPP may narrow a value space, never widen it.

TargetSelection_Procedure.title: ReportingCore · target_selection on the procedure
TargetSelection_Procedure.description: Composed into a TAPP (prov:Plan) schema: what the procedure asserts once, for every analysis that follows it.

ada:targetSelectionCriteriaDefault.description: The rules governing which part of the sample is analysed, and why. Covers the criteria applied when choosing grains, aliquots, spots, or a region of interest — size, morphology, clarity, freedom from inclusions or alteration, phase identity, or spatial position. Distinct from Target Material, which states the material type the procedure is designed for: this field states how, within such a sample, the analysed portion is picked out.

schema:defaultValue.description: Imaging or other characterisation performed before the measurement in order to select or locate the analysed target, including the technique, instrument and settings used, and how individual analyses are linked back to the images. Distinct from any imaging the procedure performs as its own measurement. Where the imaging is performed on a separate instrument, it should also be recorded in the Group 1 coupling fields.

CalibrationFactor_Procedure.title: ReportingCore · calibration_factor on the procedure
CalibrationFactor_Procedure.description: Composed into a TAPP (prov:Plan) schema: what the procedure asserts once, for every analysis that follows it.

schema:defaultValue.description: An externally-calibrated factor that converts the measured quantity into the reported quantity, how it was determined, and its uncertainty. Applies where the conversion depends on a factor calibrated against a reference of independently known value, rather than on the instrument response alone. Distinct from the fields that name the calibration material and that state which approach applies to which analyte, where the technique has them: this field records the resulting factor itself.

Blank_Analysis.title: ReportingCore · blank on the analysis
Blank_Analysis.description: Composed into a technique detail (schema:Dataset) schema: what each run supplies fresh, because it cannot be known until the analysis happens.

schema:value.description: The measured level of the analytical blank in the session, and — where the reported quantity is a ratio — its composition, since a blank subtracted from a ratio biases the result unless its own composition is known. Companion to the blank correction method, which is procedure-level: this field records what was actually measured. Follows the criterion-versus-measurement split the library applies wherever a procedure sets a threshold and an analysis reports a value against it.

Aggregation_Procedure.title: ReportingCore · aggregation on the procedure
Aggregation_Procedure.description: Composed into a TAPP (prov:Plan) schema: what the procedure asserts once, for every analysis that follows it.

schema:value.description: The rules determining which individual analyses contribute to a reported aggregate result, together with the outcome of applying them: how many analyses were acquired, how many were included, and on what grounds any were excluded. Distinct from within-analysis outlier filtering, which removes anomalous points inside a single analysis: this field decides which whole analyses enter the reported value. Criteria and outcome are combined in one field because neither is interpretable without the other, following the precision/accuracy precedent.

AggregationQc_Analysis.title: ReportingCore · aggregation_qc on the analysis
AggregationQc_Analysis.description: Composed into a technique detail (schema:Dataset) schema: what each run supplies fresh, because it cannot be known until the analysis happens.

dqv:value.description: The statistic reported to show whether scatter among the contributing analyses exceeds what analytical uncertainty alone predicts, together with its value. Answers whether a reported aggregate is defensible as a single population. Procedure-level tier is N/A because the value cannot be known before the analysis; the procedure may still state an acceptance threshold, which belongs with the inclusion criteria.
